security.quarantinedBannerDesc: The access token has been revoked, blocking configuration sync and TLS private key fetches. Clean or rebuild the host before lifting quarantine and redeploying.

security.rotateAcmeLabel: Automatically re-issue and revoke affected ACME certificates
security.rotateAcmeHint: Dispatches replacement issuance and CRL keyCompromise revocation for matching ACME certificates in this node audit log.
